The **Mole Miner Gauntlet** is a melee weapon in *Fallout 76*.

The gauntlet is made up of a simple handhold, a yellow handguard and two identical blades on the front. It can be upgraded with a bladed mod to add bleeding and extra damage. Visually, this mod also adds a third blade.
